label: rem:knot-complement-group
title: Fundamental group of the knot complement
html:
For a knot K\subset \mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C}), the fundamental group \pi_1(\mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C})\setminus K) encodes the topology of the complement. A representation

  \rho\colon\pi_1(\mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C})\setminus K)
   \longrightarrow \mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{C})

maps each meridian generator to a Möbius transformation of the Riemann sphere. The image of \rho characterises the geometric structure on the knot complement. A precise form of this for a hyperbolic knot complement M = \mathbb{H}^3/\Gamma: if a representation \rho\colon \Gamma \to PSL(2,\mathbb{C}) has |\mathrm{vol}(\rho)| = \mathrm{vol}(M), then \rho is conjugate to the inclusion, in particular discrete and faithful [francaviglia2003, §4].
